newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer on crude futures gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer on crude futures gains.

text.p: Most NWE oil products were firmer on Wednesday in a catch-up to gains on futures, traders said.
Gasoline rose on the back of firmer NYMEX, which opened the arb window from Europe. Eurograde barges ended near $189 a tonne fob NWE. Naphtha was firmer on potential demand from Asia.
Gas oil barge outright levels rose a dollar with IPE futures. Sellers stuck at Tuesday's premiums but buyers were reluctant.
High sulphur fuel cargoes rose $1/$1.50 to $88/$88.50 with prompt supplies seen tight. Low sulphur barges were traded steady at $95 fob.
